ships.label: Umi-bune

ships.creator: urszulaczyz

sourceOrientation.evidence: The paired bow anchors identify local -X as forward, the stern oar bank identifies local +X as aft, and the hull underside lies below the deck on Y.

ships.label: Kobaya
ships.identifiedType: light Japanese scout and fighting boat
ships.identificationNotes: The purchased source is an artist's reconstruction. Its 20 static oars are removed and replaced with eight widely spaced animated oars for a readable light-warship silhouette.
ships.creator: HIROKAZU KOBAYASHI

sourceOrientation.evidence: The rudder is centred at the +X end, identifying +X as stern and -X as bow; the deck and protective shields rise on +Y while the keel lies below them on -Y.

ships.label: Sekibune
ships.identificationNotes: The purchased source is an artist's reconstruction. Its 64 static oars are removed and replaced with 10 animated oars so the historical long-bank silhouette remains legible at gameplay scale.
ships.creator: HIROKAZU KOBAYASHI

sourceOrientation.evidence: The rudder is centred at the +X end, identifying +X as stern and -X as bow; the deck and mast rise on +Y while the keel lies below them on -Y.

ships.label: Kancabash
ships.assetLabel: Ottoman Coastal Trade Tall Ship 3D Model
ships.identificationNotes: The hooked bow, single fore-and-aft mast, and headsail match published Kancabaş coastal-trade plans. The surviving plan is later than 1522, so the game uses it as a representative Ottoman regional trader rather than an exact reconstruction for the start year.
ships.creator: Polygora
ships.sourceTitle: Ottoman Coastal Trade Tall Ship 3D Model
